```{r}
# SET WORKING DIRECTORY
setwd("D:/canine-seq")
wd <- getwd()

# SET CONSTANTS
min_alpha = 0.05
min_logfold = 1
time_levels = c(0, 3, 7, 10, 28, 49)
min_count = 10
min_samples = 2

# SET FILE PATHS
sample_sheet_path = "D:/canine-seq/data/ORBIT/sample_sheet.csv"
gtf_file_path = "D:/canine-seq/reference/dog/canfam4/Canis_lupus_familiarisgsd.UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0.116.gtf.gz"
kallisto_path = "D:/canine-seq/results/ORBIT/kallisto"
```

```{r}
build_tx2gene <- function(gtf_file_path){
  tx2gene <- rtracklayer::readGFF(gtf_file_path) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    dplyr::select(transcript_id, gene_id, gene_name) |>
    distinct() |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(transcript_id)) |>
    mutate(gene_name = coalesce(gene_name, gene_id))
    return(tx2gene)}

prepare_samples <- function(sample_sheet_path, time_levels){
  sample_sheet <- read.csv(sample_sheet_path) |>
    mutate(time = factor(time, levels = time_levels),
           time_num = as.numeric(time),
           subject = factor(subject),
           sample_name = paste0("Subject ", subject, ", ", "Day ", time))
  rownames(sample_sheet) <- sample_sheet$sample_id

  return(sample_sheet)}

import_kallisto <- function(kallisto_path, tx2gene, sample_sheet){
  files <- file.path(list.dirs(kallisto_path)[-1], "abundance.h5")
  names(files) <- sample_sheet$sample_id
  txi <- tximport(files, type = "kallisto",
                tx2gene = tx2gene,
                txOut = FALSE,
                ignoreTxVersion = TRUE)
  return(txi)}


run_model <- function(txi=txi,
                      sample_sheet,
                      design,
                      reduced,
                      test = "Wald",
                      col,
                      min_count = 10,
                      min_samples = 3) {
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi,
                                  colData = sample_sheet,
                                  design = design)
  
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= min_count) >= min_samples
  dds <- dds[keep,]

  if (test == "LRT") {
    dds <- DESeq(dds, test = test, reduced = reduced)
  }
  else {
    dds <- DESeq(dds, test = test)
  }
  return(dds)}

process_counts <- function(counts, sample_sheet) {
  counts <- counts |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("OR"),
                 names_to = "sample_id",
                 values_to = "count") |>
    left_join(sample_sheet, by = "sample_id") |>
    left_join(tx2gene, by = "gene_id") |>
    dplyr::select(-transcript_id)
  }
  
process_results <- function(res, tx2gene, min_alpha = 0.05, min_logfold = 1){
  res <- res |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    rownames_to_column("gene_id") |>
    left_join(tx2gene, by = "gene_id") |>
    dplyr::select(-transcript_id) |>
    distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    filter(!is.na(padj)) |>
    arrange(padj) |>
    filter(padj <= min_alpha) |>
    filter(abs(log2FoldChange) >= min_logfold)
    return(res)}
```


```{r}
# IMPORT NECESSARY DATA
tx2gene <- build_tx2gene(gtf_file_path)
sample_sheet <- prepare_samples(sample_sheet_path, time_levels)
txi <- import_kallisto(kallisto_path, tx2gene, sample_sheet)
counts <- process_counts(txi$counts, sample_sheet)

all(rownames(sample_sheet)==colnames(txi))
```

```{r}
#QUALITY CONTROL
# Count distribution per sample. They should have about equal distributions. 
counts |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x=log2(count+1)), position = "identity", bins = 200) +
  labs(x = "log2(count +1)",
       y = "Number of Genes") +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(subject),
             cols = vars(time))
```


```{r}
# MODEL FITTING

# TIME + SUBJECT LRT W/ TIME AS FACTOR # non linear effects over time
# shows the genes that are differentially expressed over time accounting for variation between subjects
dds <- run_model(txi,
                  sample_sheet,
                  design = ~ subject + time,
                  reduced = ~ subject,
                  test = "LRT",
                  col = time,
                  min_count = min_count,
                  min_samples = min_samples)

counts_norm <- process_counts(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE), sample_sheet)
```

```{r}
glimmaMDS(dds) #color by subject, shape by time.
# 46% of variance explained by subject

#normalizationFactors(dds)
plotDispEsts(dds) # Black points should cluster around the fitted line.


# visualizing shrinkage of log fold change
res <- results(dds)
plotMA(res, alpha = 0.1, ylim = c(-2, 2), cex=1.5, main = "MA-plot before LFC shrinkage")

resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = "time_49_vs_0", type="apeglm")
plotMA(resLFC, alpha = 0.1, ylim = c(-2, 2), cex=1.5, main = "MA-plot after LFC shrinkage")
```

```{r}
# getting a data frame that has log fold change, p val and gene name for every coefficient
coefficients <- resultsNames(dds)

df_list <- list()
for (coef in coefficients[-1]){
  res_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = coef, type = "apeglm")
  res_df <- process_results(res_shrunk, tx2gene, min_alpha = 10000, min_logfold = 0)
  res_df <- res_df |>
    mutate(coefficient = coef)
  df_list <- append(df_list, list(res_df))
}

df <- do.call(rbind, df_list)
```

```{r}
df_filter <- df |>
  mutate(regulation = case_when(
    (padj < min_alpha & abs(log2FoldChange) > min_logfold & log2FoldChange > 0) ~ "upregulated",
     (padj < min_alpha & abs(log2FoldChange) > min_logfold & log2FoldChange < 0) ~ "downregulated",
    T ~ "nonDE")) |>
  filter(regulation != "nonDE" & coefficient != "subject_2_vs_1") |>
  mutate(time = str_extract(coefficient, "(?<=time_)\\d+"))
```


```{r}
plot_df <- df_filter |>
  left_join(counts_norm, by = c("gene_id", "gene_name"))
  
```
